name: Athreos, Shroud-Veiled
oracle_text:
Indestructible
As long as your devotion to white and black is less than seven, Athreos isn't a creature.
At the beginning of your end step, put a coin counter on another target creature.
Whenever a creature with a coin counter on it dies or is put into exile, return that card to the battlefield under your control.
blocked_sentences: As long as your devotion to white and black is less than seven, Athreos isn't a creature.

needs.what: a static value for devotion to two colours (rule 700.5a): the number of mana symbols in the mana costs of permanents you control that are white OR black, where a hybrid {W/B} pip counts once, not twice -- e.g. mana_symbols accepting a list `of: ["W", "B"]` that counts each pip at most once if it contains any listed colour
needs.why_existing_wont_do: mana_symbols takes a single colour in `of` (validate_mana_symbols refuses anything else), and summing mana_symbols of W plus mana_symbols of B double-counts every {W/B} hybrid pip because Requirement.symbols_of in engine/mana.py counts a hybrid pip for each of its colours; no static value subtracts hybrid pips, so the God would become a creature too early
